left.text: The Pediatric Cancer Data Commons supports the management, analysis and sharing of data for the research community.
The PCDC harnesses pediatric, AYA, and adult cancer clinical data from around the world into a single unified platform, making it possible to explore and access data across multiple types of cancer.

cards.bodyText: The Pediatric Cancer Data Commons defines the data. Please study the dictionary before you start browsing.
The Exploration Page gives you insights and a clear overview under selected factors.
